decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed two storey rear extension, front entrance redevelopment and extension of the existing front fence by reason of its size, scale, positioning and complementary design has due regard for the sites characteristics and the dynamics of the surrounding built environment and would not be detrimental to the amenity of the locality or the adjoining properties.  It would allow for the sites continued facilitation as an accommodation premises without compromising the areas residential integrity or traffic related amenity and is therefore in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) E.5.1 (Visitor Accommodation) T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and T.4.1 (Traffic Implications of New Development) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on site outside the hours of 8am to 6pm Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays.
description: Erection of lower ground and ground floor rear extension, refurbishment of existing entrance to provide disabled access and repair and extension of existing boundary wall to existing hotel
